content: {"like":["Enjoys cheesy fun moments in 1980s action‑adventure films","Prefers energetic, family‑friendly animation with classic Disney charm","Values campy, silly Bond portrayals, especially Roger Moore’s style","Appreciates realistic, physically capable Daniel Craig in serious Bond tone","Loves classic Flash Gordon performances by Buster Crabbe"],"dislike":["Dislikes Dolph Lundgren and Frank Langella in action movies","Rejects overblown CGI-heavy Hollywood remakes like King Kong","Avoids producers’ influence and Flash Gordon references in Masters of the Universe","Dislikes fast‑forwarded credits and cringe‑inducing theme songs in Bond releases","Finds watered‑down adaptations, such as Dark Knight Returns, lacking original depth"]}
